10k.note: 10-K describes molecular-diagnostics business: smNGS platform with QCT technology powering UNITY (prenatal NIPT for recessive conditions, aneuploidy, RhD, fetal antigen) and Northstar (Select / Response / PGx / Select CH) pan-cancer liquid biopsy tests. No proprietary therapeutic pipeline.

website.skipped: Diagnostics company; corporate site lists assays/products, not a drug pipeline.

ctgov.note: Two records list BillionToOne as collaborator: NCT07096362 (Univ of Miami sponsor; ctDNA-guided FOLFIRINOX switch in mPDAC, Phase 2) and NCT05733689 (UC Irvine sponsor; RANT-GC, Phase 1). In both, BillionToOne provides the ctDNA assay; the drugs (FOLFIRINOX, FOLFOX, FOLFIRI, FLOT, nivolumab, pembrolizumab, durvalumab, trastuzumab, etc.) are not BillionToOne assets. Excluded as partner-owned / investigator-initiated.

prenatal: UNITY Fetal Risk Screen (sgNIPT for recessive conditions including SCD, alpha/beta thalassemia, CF, SMA; up to 14 conditions)
UNITY Fetal Antigen NIPT (D, C, c, E, K, Fya); expanded RBC + first-and-only Platelet Fetal Antigen NIPT (announced Feb 2026)
UNITY Fetal Antigen CTA NIPT (companion diagnostic for J&J nipocalimab AZALEA Phase 3; FDA IDE granted Apr 2023)
oncology: Northstar Select (pan-cancer ctDNA therapy-selection liquid biopsy; MolDX coverage 2025)
Northstar Response (methylation-based pan-cancer therapy monitoring; updated May 2025 to >2,200 loci, 0.01% LOD)
Northstar PGx (launched Jan 2026; chemotherapy pharmacogenomics add-on)
Northstar Select CH (launched Feb 2026; clonal hematopoiesis add-on)
MRD test in development; expected commercial availability Q4 2026

excluded_partner_owned: NCT07096362 (mFOLFIRINOX in mPDAC — Univ of Miami sponsor; BillionToOne provides ctDNA assay)
NCT05733689 (RANT-GC neoadjuvant gastroesophageal — UC Irvine sponsor; BillionToOne is collaborator)
J&J AZALEA Phase 3 of nipocalimab (BillionToOne provides UNITY Fetal Antigen CTA companion diagnostic only)
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Molecular-diagnostics / lab-services company (services_cro_lab bucket). BillionToOne develops and markets cfDNA-based diagnostic assays (UNITY prenatal, Northstar oncology) but owns no therapeutic drug INDs. Trials in which the company appears are sponsor-client / investigator-initiated studies that use its assays as the test article or as a companion diagnostic; per scope rules these are excluded from the drug pipeline.
